landing.subtitle: Report an incident in minutes, and see where others have reported them across Sri Lanka.
landing.problemBody: It is hard to tell whether an unfamiliar road, public place or transport stop is safe. Information about incidents is scattered across social media, personal networks and informal chats, so recurring patterns stay hidden.

report.title: Report
report.body: Write or speak what you experienced or saw. Time, place and extra details are optional.

analyse.title: AI reads it
analyse.body: A category, an estimate of seriousness and key details are suggested, always kept apart from your own words.

check.title: Integrity check
check.body: Reports may be checked for duplicates or unusual patterns. That is a signal, not a judgement about you.

map.title: Area summaries
map.body: Only privacy-protected area summaries reach the map, never your description or exact location.

estimate.title: AI gives estimates
estimate.body: Categories and seriousness are suggestions, not verified facts. Unknown never means low.

notSafe.title: Few reports is not safe
notSafe.body: Many reports can reflect more people or more reporting. Few reports can mean few people reported, not that an area is safe.

privacy.title: Your words stay private
privacy.body: The public view shows approximate areas and report counts only. Location is used only if you choose to share it.

sos.title: SOS calls someone you trust
sos.body: SOS calls your emergency contact from your own phone. SafeStep does not alert anyone for you.

audience.travellers: Girls and women who travel alone
audience.planners: Anyone who wants to know what has been reported before visiting a place
audience.contributors: Community members who want to contribute incident reports

landing.finalTitle: What you know can help the next person.
landing.finalBody: Reporting takes about two minutes and every question after the first is optional.

footer.disclaimer: SafeStep cannot guarantee that any place or route is safe. It shows reported incidents and estimates only.
footer.demo: This is a demo: AI results and map data are synthetic samples.
footer.backendMap: Map areas come from the backend. Other features may still use demo data.

sos.desktopHint: On a computer? A call can only start on a phone, so dial {{number}} from your phone.

map.slotBody: The map is being built separately and will appear here. Area details are available in the list.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.
